h:
这是一个非常简单的 ComfyUI 初学者友好的图像到图像工作流程，它将与具有多个 LORA 的单个 WAN 2.1 GGUF 模型一起使用（此工作流程确实需要 ComfyUI 的 LORA Manager 插件才能运行。最好安装 ComfyUI 管理器和 LORA Manager 插件，以帮助您轻松下载和管理检查点、LORA 和其他资源。这两个不仅对此工作流程有帮助，而且在任何其他情况下都会为您提供很大帮助）。您需要一个 Hugging Face 帐户来下载必要的 WAN 2.1 文件（详细信息如下所述）。确保使用 ComfyUI 管理器为 ComfyUI 安装 GGUF 插件，并将正确的文件放置在正确的位置。另请查看我的 SD 1.5 + SDXL 1.0、SD 3.5、HiDream 和 通量。

如何使用这个 -

#1.只需先选择您想要的 WAN 2.1 GGUF 型号，然后加载

#2.从 LORA Manager 启动一个或多个匹配的 LORA

＃3。然后选择一个输入图像来写下输出的正面和负面提示。

＃4。选择您想要的图像数量（更改“运行”按钮旁边的数字）

＃5。选择图像采样方法、CFG、步骤等设置

＃6。最后按运行按钮生成。就是这样..

*** 如果您知道如何正确禁用 LORA 节点并绕过它，此工作流程也将起作用，并且我认为通过细微调整，它可以转换为具有 LORA 支持的 GGUF 模型的可行图像到视频工作流程。

享受吧！

o.en:
This is a very simple ComfyUI beginner friendly Image-to-Image workflow that will work with a single WAN 2.1 GGUF model with multiple LORAs (This workflow does require ComfyUI's LORA Manager plugin to function. It is a good idea to install both ComfyUI manager and LORA Manager plugin to help you easily download and manage Checkpoints, LORAs and other resources. Not only these two are helpful for this workflow but they will help you a lot in any other cases). You need a Hugging Face account to download your necessary WAN 2.1 files (Details are mentioned below). Make sure you install GGUF addon for ComfyUI using ComfyUI manager and place the correct files in correct places. Also check out my other workflows for SD 1.5 + SDXL 1.0, SD 3.5, HiDream and Flux.

How to use this -

#1. Just select your desired WAN 2.1 GGUF model first and then load

#2. one or multiple matching LORA(s) from LORA Manager to start

#3. then select an input image to write your positive and negative prompts for output.

#4. select how many images you want (Change the number besides the "Run" button)

#5. select image sampling methods, CFG, steps etc. settings

#6. finally press the run button to generate. That's it..

*** This workflow will also function if you know how to properly disable the LORA Node and bypass it, and I think with minor tweaks it can be transformed into a viable Image-to-video workflow for GGUF model with LORA support.

Enjoy!

### To use this workflow you need to log into huggingface and download necessary files from there (I also included a text file on the archive that has the workflow file, in which you will find even more links for essential downloads for my other workflows) -
